$description: Spotlight (platform/components/Spotlight, library wave 5, lane B): its component tokens. The dim is the scrim role at the middle opacity (as the modal scrim); the beacon is the brand color with a ring in the color on the brand.

spotlight-dim-background.$description: Spotlight: the dimmed panels, in the scrim role.

spotlight-dim-opacity.$description: Spotlight: the dim's opacity (the modal scrim's).

spotlight-padding.$description: Spotlight: the clear space between the target's edges and the dim.

spotlight-z-index.$description: Spotlight over the window: the overlay layer, under the bubble or dialog that explains it.

spotlight-contained-z-index.$description: Contained spotlight: one layer over the region's content.

spotlight-animation-duration.$description: Spotlight: the dim's fade in (the scrim's).

spotlight-animation-timing-function.$description: Spotlight: the easing of the fade and the pulse.

spotlight-beacon-offset.$description: Beacon: half its size, so it is centered on the target's top end corner.

spotlight-beacon-color.$description: Beacon: the dot, in the brand blue (as the teaching bubble).

spotlight-beacon-ring-color.$description: Beacon: its ring, the color on the brand blue, so it shows on any target.
